categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Categories drive the storefront’s top-level navigation.

reorder.subtitle: Drag rows to reorder. Lower shows first on the storefront.
reorder.noChanges: Drag a row to change the order.

empty.intro: Set up at least one size group before creating categories.

form.name: Name
form.iconHint: Pick a category icon. Manage the library in Catalog → Category Icons.
form.orderHint: Lower numbers show first on the storefront.
form.newDescription: Bilingual name, one size group, one image.

soft.title: Remove "{{name}}"?
soft.description: The category will be hidden from the storefront but can be restored from the Deleted tab.

hard.title: Permanently delete "{{name}}"?
hard.description: This removes the category from the database. Sub-categories and products referencing it may break.

subCategories.title: Sub-categories
subCategories.subtitle: Sub-categories belong to a parent category and refine browsing.

empty.intro: Create a parent category first, then add sub-categories underneath.

form.newDescription: Pick a parent category, then add localized names.
form.name: Name

soft.title: Remove "{{name}}"?
soft.description: The sub-category will be hidden but can be restored from the Deleted tab.

hard.title: Permanently delete "{{name}}"?
hard.description: This removes the sub-category from the database. Any products referencing it may break.

colors.title: Colors
colors.subtitle: Colors are reused across product variants. Keep the palette tight.

empty.title: No colors yet
empty.description: Add colors before creating product variants.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: Any product variant using this color will keep its existing hex but lose this label. This action cannot be undone.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.subtitle: Sizes belong to a group and control sort order on the storefront.

empty.title: No sizes yet
empty.description: Add sizes to a group so categories can use them on the storefront.

form.newDescription: Each size belongs to one group.

delete.title: Delete size "{{name}}"?
delete.description: Any product variant using this size may stop rendering correctly. This action cannot be undone.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Size groups define whether a category uses letter-style or numeric sizing.

empty.title: No size groups yet
empty.description: Create a group before adding individual sizes or categories.

form.newDescription: Give this sizing group a name.
form.name: Name

icons.title: Category Icons
icons.subtitle: Reusable SVG icons assigned to categories. Keys must be unique.

empty.title: No icons yet
empty.description: Add SVG icons before assigning them to categories.

form.newDescription: Paste SVG markup and give it a unique key.
form.editDescription: Update the SVG markup or toggle availability for "{{name}}".
form.previewPrompt: Paste SVG markup to see a preview.
form.activeHint: Inactive icons stay in the library but are hidden from category pickers.

delete.description: Categories assigned to this icon will lose their icon link. This action cannot be undone.
